name: KV quantization ladder
canonical_description: Selects key/value cache precision and size to fit a context target.
mechanism: Selects KV-cache precision or quantization—such as fp16, q8_0, q4_0, or an engine-specific FP8 KV setting—to trade cache memory against usable context and concurrency.
constraints: Requires engine/runtime support for the selected KV dtype or cache-quantization setting.
The usable context ceiling depends on total memory, weight footprint, speculative/MTP state, and the selected KV precision.
tradeoffs: Lower KV precision reduces cache memory, but quality effects require same-scope correctness or quality measurements.
A recorded context ceiling is setup-specific and may not be compared across different weights, engines, or KV settings without explicit conditions.
re_review_triggers: Engine KV-cache dtype support or defaults change.
A setup compares KV-ladder context ceilings without recording both cache precision and context/workload conditions.
A setup claims a quality effect from KV quantization without linked same-scope quality evidence.

canonical_sources.locator: 'Which one fits your card' and the attention-cache-per-token/context budget table
canonical_sources.note: Vendor card recording that both file and context must fit, with explicit context-memory budgeting.

canonical_sources.locator: Context Scaling Matrix for fp16/Q8/Q4 KV and MTP Overdrive
canonical_sources.note: Archived builder thread recording an fp16/Q8/Q4 KV ladder and the resulting context ceilings on a single RTX 4090.

note: Canonical technique identity only. A setup-specific claim must still carry its own statement, source, locator, lineage, evidence level, and contrast kind.
